issue.title: Highlight block IDs hash ordinal_on_page, so inserting a highlight above others re-mints and tombstones every later ^h- ID on that page
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/native/highlights_ref/sidecar_render.rs::annotation_block_id` (hashes `ordinal_on_page`), fed by `sidecar.rs::flush_sidecar_chunk`

Text-highlight and standalone-note block IDs (`^h-…`) hash the source PDF, kind,
page label, **`ordinal_on_page`**, and text. Highlights orders a page's annotations
by position, so a new highlight placed *above* existing ones on the same page shifts
the ordinal of every later annotation on that page. Each of them gets a new
`^h-` ID, and every old ID is tombstoned under `### Removed highlights`.

Reproduced in the vault's own history for `ref/blogs/gas_town_emergency_user_manual.md`
(`git -C ~/bob show <commit>:ref/blogs/gas_town_emergency_user_manual.md | grep -E '^(### |\^h-)'`):

- `94b786eb`: Page 9 = `h-ab3f80f326b4 h-4462b6562b19 h-028f34fba39e`
- `69d1050c` (one caption highlight added at the top of p.9, the other three unchanged):
  Page 9 = `h-36fa970fb80b h-b847daf83afa h-c84b12ae53a2 h-89983d37707f`, and all
  three old IDs now sit in `### Removed highlights`.

So 3 of that note's 5 tombstones exist only because one highlight was inserted.

Impact: `🔖` backlinks on annotation-created tasks (`[[#^h-…]]` / `[[ref/…#^h-…]]`)
end up pointing at tombstones instead of the live quote. Tombstone clutter builds up
in every note where Bryan goes back and highlights earlier text on a page. Any future
feature keyed to block identity (for example the proposed `<` continuation-merge for
cross-page highlights) inherits this fragility.

Fix sketch (needs design): stop hashing the ordinal. Use page + kind + normalized
text, and add a disambiguator only when two annotations on the same page have
identical text (identical-text collisions are what the ordinal was guarding). Existing
IDs need a migration story: for example, keep an existing block's ID when its
(page, text) still matches, so no current note re-mints everything.

task_type_fields.impact: Task backlinks point at tombstones; Removed highlights clutter grows; identity-keyed features inherit the churn
task_type_fields.repro: Add a new highlight above existing highlights on one PDF page in Highlights, run bob ref scan, and every later block on that page gets a new ^h- ID while the old IDs move to Removed highlights (see vault commits 94b786eb -> 69d1050c for ref/blogs/gas_town_emergency_user_manual.md)

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching cross-page highlight merging for bob ref: the gas town ref note's own git history shows one inserted highlight tombstoning three unchanged ones, which breaks task backlinks and clutters notes.

payload.description: Verify ordinal-churn bead cited by highlight merge research

evidence.note: Independent impact evidence from the underline-emphasis research: flush_sidecar_chunk (sidecar.rs:285-289) counts Highlights underline rows in ordinal_on_page. In the current vault 3 of 19 underline rows sort before their host highlight (Gas Town pp. 4, 7, 10; p. 4's underline starts at the host's first word), so underlining a phrase inside an already-published highlight re-mints that host's ^h- ID and every later ID on the page, producing Removed-highlight tombstones. The recommended underline-emphasis fold makes 'go back and underline part of an existing highlight' a routine workflow, so this fix should land before or with that feature.

payload.entry: Lander bob-cli-an.land verified 2026-10-23. bob-cli commit 51ad4f4c removed ordinal_on_page from new IDs, which now hash source, kind, page, and normalized text. The planner reuses existing live and removed IDs one to one before allocating, keeps legacy ordinal IDs as valid addresses, and returns write-free ambiguity errors instead of guessing. The plan is threaded through rendering, fold, stub, and task-link paths. Later epic bob-cli-ap (5376dc6e, f2c24531, 510c8a44) integrated tucked continuation groups through the same plan via group_identity_text. Regression tests highlight_identity_survives_insertion_and_underline_absorption and highlight_identity_handles_duplicates_comments_legacy_and_folds pass. Focused cargo test --lib highlights_ref passes 596/596, and just check on integrated master c07a65cc exits 0 (lib 3175 passed, 1 ignored). The docs contract is in docs/highlights-ref-sync.md.
